verdict.rationale: Poly has a built-in agent that can summarize, explain, and act on your files inside the product. It handles multi-step reading, searching, and organizing tasks. It also automatically remembers key details from your files as a 'second brain' and supports natural-language search over them. missing for 10: evidence of proactive AI-generated suggestions or insights (beyond on-demand summarize/explain), detail on what kinds of insights are surfaced, independent or hands-on corroboration of output quality.
